meta.name: child_parent_short_visual_presets_updated
meta.notes: Updated from v1.1.0. Key changes: (1) adult_hand_action renamed 'moving toy' -> 'manipulating toy' to match both Miami and ENS human annotation vocabulary; added aliases for ENS-specific terms 'holding toy still' and 'grabbing toy'. (2) current_toy question text corrected to say 'yellow toy' instead of 'red toy'. (3) few_shot answers updated accordingly.

global_instructions.system_prompt: Analyze visual behavior of the people from this video. Return EXACTLY one label from the allowed options. Output the label ONLY. No punctuation, no extra words, no sentences.

presets.title: Toy Engagement Overall
presets.question: Is there a toy being held by someone? Choose one: yes or no.

presets.title: Parent Holding Toy
presets.question: Is the adult holding a toy? Choose one: yes or no.

presets.title: Child Holding Toy
presets.question: Is the child holding a toy? Choose one: yes or no.

presets.title: Child Hand Action
presets.question: What is the child's current hand action? Choose one: pointing, grabbing toy, giving away the toy, holding toy still, manipulating toy, gesturing, touching adult, on the ground, on some furniture, resting, none.

presets.title: Child Spatial Proximity
presets.question: What is the child's proximity and orientation relative to the adult? Shoulder to shoulder is considered a close distance. Choose one: close and facing toward adult, close but facing away from adult, mid distance and facing toward adult, mid distance and facing away from adult, far and facing toward adult, far but facing away from adult, not visible.
choices: close but facing away from adult
mid distance and facing toward adult
mid distance and facing away from adult
far but facing away from adult

aliases.mid distance and facing toward: mid distance and facing toward adult
aliases.mid distance and facing away: mid distance and facing away from adult
aliases.far but facing away: far but facing away from adult
aliases.close but facing away: close but facing away from adult

presets.title: Current Toy Interaction
presets.question: Which toy is the child holding in their hands? Choose one: none, giraffe, elephant, yellow toy, green toy.

presets.title: Adult Hand Action
presets.question: What is the adult's primary hand action in this clip? Choose one: pointing, handing toy to child, taking toy from child, holding toy, holding paper, manipulating toy, touching child, resting, opening a box or bag, waving, none.

presets.title: Child Pose
presets.question: What is the child's posture? Choose one: sitting still, standing still, walking, crawling, turning around, bending over, not visible.

presets.title: Adult Pose
presets.question: What is the adult's posture? Choose one: sitting, standing still, walking, crawling, turning around, bending over, not visible.
